text: We tested weak-to-strong generalization using reweighting weak labels by the frozen strong model's margin, with a margin temperature of 1.0, a gpt2-medium weak supervisor, and llama-3.1-8b as the strong student, across 5 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.55 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling accuracy was 0.87. Training the strong model on the reweighted weak labels yielded a transfer accuracy of 0.84 (SE 0.04) and a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.92 with a standard error of 0.11, against a baseline PGR of 0.11. The PGR exceeds the baseline by more than two standard errors, so the margin-based reweighting appears to recover substantially more of the weak-to-strong gap than the baseline under this setup. Caveats: the estimate rests on only 5 seeds and a PGR standard error of 0.11, a single weak/strong model pair, and one margin temperature setting, so the magnitude should be treated as approximate and generalization to other pairings remains untested.
